title: Assessing Language Model Deployment with Risk Cards

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative manual probing to elicit hate speech, negative stereotypes, and identity attacks against various social groups, documented using the RiskCards framework.
Demonstrated via a specific 'Hate speech' RiskCard example using prompts targeting Black people to exemplify the documentation of representational harms.
Included in the RiskCards starter set through risks such as 'Calls for conversion' and 'Sexualisation', identified via literature survey and manual model interaction.
